I build digital products from zero to launch

Full-stack development, product strategy, and everything in between. I take ideas from concept to production — from landing pages to complex platforms with custom backends.

WHAT I BUILD
Websites

Custom-coded websites with clean architecture, responsive layouts, and performance optimization. No templates, no page builders.

Landing Pages

Conversion-driven pages with integrated analytics, A/B testing infrastructure, and sub-second load times. Built to perform.

Full-Stack Applications

SaaS platforms, admin dashboards, custom CRM systems — complete backend-to-frontend solutions designed to scale with your business.

Telegram Bots

Production-grade bots with payment processing, AI integration, and sophisticated user flows. Designed for real business operations.

API Integrations

Seamless connections between payment gateways, CRMs, AI services, and third-party platforms. Reliable architecture with proper error handling.

Support & Hosting

Server configuration, deployment pipelines, SSL, uptime monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. Long-term reliability, not just a launch.
